# Nomadic Labs

> Power. Water. Signal. Code.

Nomadic Labs is the umbrella home for independent software, media, AI systems, engineering work, research, client work, and release evidence built by AnonymousNomad.

Canonical site: https://nomadic-labs.dev/

## Builder

AnonymousNomad is an independent developer with an electrical-work background who builds software, AI systems, media products, and practical technical projects.

Public themes:
- hands-on engineering
- verify-first development
- local-first systems where appropriate
- off-grid independence
- outdoors and frontier influence
- gaming and science-fiction influence
- evidence-backed claims rather than marketing inflation

Private workstation data, credentials, personal records, and private model memory are not public website data.

## Project worlds

### Nomadic TV

Nomadic TV is an active streaming-platform project centered on live channels, guide-driven discovery, movies and shows, household media, and a television experience designed to feel like television rather than endless thumbnail scrolling.

Current public status: active development and content/provider outreach.

The Nomadic TV visual identity will remain distinct when migrated under Nomadic Labs.

### Nexus / ToolNeuron

Nexus is the planned community and catalog surface for models, skills, plugins, packages, developer tools, and community publishing.

The existing Nexus visual direction is preserved. Production migration is intended to support real accounts, publishers, submissions, moderation, package versions and hashes, downloads, APIs, and administration.

Current public status: migration and product development.

### Covert

Covert is a local-first governed AI developer platform focused on resident assistance, model/runtime control, context control, workflow orchestration, execution authority, verification, and evidence-backed mission results.

Current public status: active engineering.

Do not infer that unfinished Covert capabilities are released merely because they are documented or planned.

### Workshop

Nomadic Labs also covers research, prototypes, open-source contributions, release evidence, and delivered client work.

A recent client example is the Cranes Mill Baptist Church website project.

## Site architecture

Nomadic Labs is the umbrella property. Product sites remain distinct worlds.

Planned public surfaces include:
- nomadic-labs.dev — main hub
- tv.nomadic-labs.dev — Nomadic TV
- nexus.nomadic-labs.dev — Nexus
- covert.nomadic-labs.dev — Covert
- releases.nomadic-labs.dev — release/artifact surface

Specific product surfaces should only be described as live after they are actually deployed and verified.

## Engineering doctrine

Nomadic Labs follows a verify-first development pattern:

OBSERVE -> DIAGNOSE -> REPAIR -> RERUN -> VERIFY -> CONTINUE

Public shorthand:

evidence > confidence

## Website guide

The site includes an embedded public support guide.

The guide:
- answers questions about Nomadic Labs, the builder, and public projects
- is grounded in curated public information
- must distinguish active work from completed releases
- must say when information is unavailable
- must not expose credentials, private files, private memories, or workstation data

Initial inference target: Cloudflare Workers AI.

## Visual direction

The final Nomadic Labs design is intentionally not a generic SaaS portfolio.

The design direction is a restrained, professional off-grid frontier environment using:
- dark northern weather and rain
- worn electrical infrastructure
- power lines and subtle static discharge
- water and signal systems
- restrained holographic instrumentation
- original science-fiction influence
- cinematic atmosphere without copying existing franchises

Nomadic TV and Nexus retain their own visual identities.
